## Examination of loss of endemics in irrigated and non-irrigated fields

## Clear workspace and set directory

```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/irrigation/Beta_diversity")
```

# Load packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


# Functional community

```{r}
set.seed(12345)

ko01 <- read.csv("./Loss_of_endemics/Data/KOs.count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv("./Loss_of_endemics/Data/Metadata.csv", header = TRUE)

ko <- ko01[, meta$SampleID]

irrigated_samples <- meta %>%
  filter(Irrigation == "irrigated") %>%
  pull(SampleID)

nonirrigated_samples <- meta %>%
  filter(Irrigation == "non-irrigated") %>%
  pull(SampleID)

presence_matrix <- (ko > 0) * 1

ko_occ <- data.frame(
  KO = rownames(presence_matrix),
  irrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  irrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE])
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "shared",
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count == 0 ~ "unique_irrigated",
      irrigated_count == 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "unique_nonirrigated",
      TRUE ~ "absent"
    )
  )

table(ko_occ$Group)


# 1). Create non-irrigated endemic KO list
nonirrigated_endemic_KOs <- ko_occ %>%
  filter(Group == "unique_nonirrigated") %>%
  pull(KO)

length(nonirrigated_endemic_KOs)


#################################################
# Farm-level recovery of non-irrigated endemics
#################################################
nonirr_endemic_pa <- presence_matrix[
  nonirrigated_endemic_KOs,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

farm_endemic_recovery <- data.frame(
  SampleID = colnames(nonirr_endemic_pa),
  
  endemic_number =
    colSums(nonirr_endemic_pa),
  
  endemic_fraction =
    colSums(nonirr_endemic_pa) /
    length(nonirrigated_endemic_KOs)
) %>%
  left_join(
    meta %>%
      select(SampleID, Irrigation),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

head(farm_endemic_recovery)


# Two-group comparison
wilcox.test(endemic_number ~ Irrigation, data = farm_endemic_recovery, exact = FALSE)
# W = 22, p-value = 3.235e-11

wilcox.test(endemic_fraction ~ Irrigation, data = farm_endemic_recovery, exact = FALSE)
# W = 22, p-value = 3.235e-11

# Number of non-irrigated endemic KOs per irrigated farm
range(farm_endemic_recovery$endemic_number)

p_number <- ggplot(farm_endemic_recovery,
            aes(x = Irrigation, y = endemic_number, color = Irrigation)) +
  #geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  theme_bw() +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 36, label = "P < 0.001", size = 6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of endemic genes per farms", 
       title = "Loss of non-irrigated endemic genes" ) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p_number
ggsave("./Loss_of_endemics/Output/Loss of endemic genes_Fig. 5f.pdf", p_number, width = 5, height = 5.3)

```



# Taxonomic community

```{r}
set.seed(12345)

ko01 <- read.csv("./Loss_of_endemics/Data/Species.count.csv", row.names = 1, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv("./Loss_of_endemics/Data/Metadata.csv", header = TRUE)

ko <- ko01[, meta$SampleID]

irrigated_samples <- meta %>%
  filter(Irrigation == "irrigated") %>%
  pull(SampleID)

nonirrigated_samples <- meta %>%
  filter(Irrigation == "non-irrigated") %>%
  #sample_n(size = length(irrigated_samples), replace = FALSE) %>%
  pull(SampleID)

presence_matrix <- (ko > 0) * 1

ko_occ <- data.frame(
  KO = rownames(presence_matrix),
  irrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_count = rowSums(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  irrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, irrigated_samples, drop = FALSE]),
  nonirrigated_freq = rowMeans(presence_matrix[, nonirrigated_samples, drop = FALSE])
) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "shared",
      irrigated_count > 0 & nonirrigated_count == 0 ~ "unique_irrigated",
      irrigated_count == 0 & nonirrigated_count > 0 ~ "unique_nonirrigated",
      TRUE ~ "absent"
    )
  )

table(ko_occ$Group)


# 1). Create non-irrigated endemic KO list
nonirrigated_endemic_KOs <- ko_occ %>%
  filter(Group == "unique_nonirrigated") %>%
  pull(KO)

length(nonirrigated_endemic_KOs)


#################################################
# Farm-level recovery of non-irrigated endemics
#################################################
nonirr_endemic_pa <- presence_matrix[
  nonirrigated_endemic_KOs,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

farm_endemic_recovery <- data.frame(
  SampleID = colnames(nonirr_endemic_pa),
  
  endemic_number =
    colSums(nonirr_endemic_pa),
  
  endemic_fraction =
    colSums(nonirr_endemic_pa) /
    length(nonirrigated_endemic_KOs)
) %>%
  left_join(
    meta %>%
      select(SampleID, Irrigation),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

head(farm_endemic_recovery)


# Two-group comparison
wilcox.test(endemic_number ~ Irrigation, data = farm_endemic_recovery, exact = FALSE)
# W = 0, p-value = 7.377e-12

wilcox.test(endemic_fraction ~ Irrigation, data = farm_endemic_recovery, exact = FALSE)
# W = 0, p-value = 7.377e-12


# Number of non-irrigated endemic KOs per irrigated farm
range(farm_endemic_recovery$endemic_number)

p_number <- ggplot(farm_endemic_recovery,
                   aes(x = Irrigation, y = endemic_number, color = Irrigation)) +
  #geom_boxplot(width = 0.10, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_violin(fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("irrigated" = "#4169B2", "non-irrigated" = "#BB2BA0")) +
  theme_bw() +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 300, label = "P < 0.001", size = 6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of endemic taxa per farms", 
       title = "Loss of non-irrigated endemic taxa" ) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p_number
ggsave("./Loss_of_endemics/Output/Loss of endemic taxa_Fig. 5e.pdf", p_number, width = 5, height = 5.3)
```
